architecture_scope.current_ledger_observation: These Phase-3 workpackages are still NOT_STARTED in the human ledger snapshot inspected in this macrocycle; no accepted implementation is claimed here.

pipeline: optional LLM-free semantic subsegmenter inside the hard fence
typed memory separation and provenance binding

must_cut_on: session/restart recovery boundary when causal continuity is not proven
real effect request/result boundary when effect ownership changes
source/provenance class change when cross-source fusion is not explicitly admitted
hard_boundary_fence.law: Semantic similarity may merge only inside a deterministic admissible causal fence. It cannot merge across a hard boundary merely because embeddings are close.

semantic_subsegmenter.failure_mode: If embedding or boundary inference is unavailable/ambiguous, fall back to deterministic hard/fixed bounds; never lose source events.

DerivedMemorySegmentEnvelope.idempotence: segment_id must derive from exact source identities + generation + boundary method/version, not generated prose alone
DerivedMemorySegmentEnvelope.rebuildability: All derived segment/record state must be reconstructable from canonical UnifiedDB events plus exact boundary/extractor identities.

WP303_mapping.FACT: candidate factual record with direct evidence refs; not canonical fact until deterministic admission/verification path says so
WP303_mapping.METHOD: reusable investigation/execution method with prerequisites/failure modes
WP303_mapping.PROCESS_POLICY: behavioral/process recommendation requiring explicit scope and non-effect authority

typed_derived_memory.anti_collapse: Do not collapse Fact/Episode/Method/Process-Policy into one generic semantic record type because authority and reuse semantics differ.

WP300_memory_evolution.rule: Memory evolution is append/supersede/reweight/reindex over derived projections; canonical source events are never destructively forgotten or rewritten by consolidation.
WP300_memory_evolution.staleness: Superseded derived records remain historically inspectable and are excluded or down-ranked by deterministic validity/generation filters.
WP300_memory_evolution.degradation: Optional decay affects retrieval priority/confidence only; it cannot erase canonical evidence or falsify historical provenance.

WP301_emergent_retrieval.law: Relevance may emerge from overlap of independently stored dimensions; no information is minted by retrieval.

retrieval_trust_boundary.inspiration: arXiv:2606.06054 MemGate finding that similarity-only retrieval can become a durable control channel
retrieval_trust_boundary.law: A high semantic score cannot override a failed deterministic admission predicate.

WP306_ContextCompiler.input: admitted candidate evidence records plus current Situation/Control state
WP306_ContextCompiler.output: bounded ContextView with exact selected evidence IDs and omission/budget reasons
requirements: no hidden write-back from generated answer into canonical state

falsifiable_benchmark_contract.name: F2_PHASE3_SEGMENT_CONSOLIDATION_ABLATION/v1

arms.A_EAGER_TURN: model extraction after every eligible exchange
arms.B_FIXED_WINDOW: same extractor on deterministic fixed token/exchange windows
arms.C_SEMANTIC_ONLY: embedding semantic boundaries with length caps but no F2 hard causal fences
arms.D_CAUSAL_FENCED_SEMANTIC: hard F2 causal/lifecycle/generation boundaries plus semantic subsegmentation within each fence

matched_conditions: same retrieval budget and downstream model
required_negative_controls: superseded memory with higher vector similarity than current memory
same text but different causal event identity
generation change inside a semantically coherent conversation
tool/effect result arriving after the request segment
rare environment gotcha with low lexical similarity
falsifiable_benchmark_contract.decision_rule: D is preferred only if it materially reduces construction cost versus A while matching or improving evidence/provenance correctness and does not increase trust-boundary failures. If C beats D on retrieval but violates causal/provenance controls, C is rejected.

counterhypothesis_discriminators.counterhypothesis: Semantic segmentation splits causal action/outcome pairs.
counterhypothesis_discriminators.test: Inject semantically abrupt tool results that remain causally bound to the prior request; verify hard fences keep request/result lineage recoverable and compare C vs D.
Query before normal segment closure after a high-priority observation; require a bounded fresh-tail path or deterministic flush and measure stale/missing evidence.
Mutate/delete derived projection and rebuild from UnifiedDB; exact canonical event state and regenerated provenance bindings must remain intact.
Place a high-similarity wrong-domain/superseded memory above the correct lower-similarity record; deterministic admission must reject it before ranking.
